purpose: Acquire and no-return screen one sparse related-party disclosure-clustering factor for the fixed three-local-session A-share protocol without amount fields, financial denominators, text, identity persistence, price access, or return access.

source.request_partition: one inclusive notice-date range per count-complete paginated request

source_schema_policy.missing_malformed_or_unexpected_key_poli: abort the complete acceptance or full snapshot before publication
source_schema_policy.duplicate_identity_policy: abort rather than silently deduplicate or double count
source_schema_policy.complete_unsupported_board_code_policy: exclude and count before factor construction
source_schema_policy.missing_or_malformed_code_date_or_eid_po: abort rather than exclude, infer, or fill
source_schema_policy.eid_persistence_policy: use only in memory for identity uniqueness and issuer-date count, then discard before any Parquet or manifest row-level output

factor.name: eastmoney_related_party_transaction_sparsity
factor.valid_event: a supported instrument and strict in-partition notice date with one or more globally validated unique EID identities
factor.valid_factor_range: strictly greater than zero and no greater than one
factor.invalid_row_policy: follow the source-schema fatal/exclusion rules exactly; never clip, fill, infer, deduplicate, change sign, substitute a field, or inspect a transported alternative
factor.absent_value_policy: missing; never zero, infinity, one, or any favorable score

point_in_time_policy.conservative_availability: first local trading session strictly after NOTICE_DATE
point_in_time_policy.multiple_notice_dates: each issuer-date event is independent; a later event supersedes an older event only when the later event becomes available
point_in_time_policy.weekend_or_holiday_notice: map to the first local trading session strictly after the calendar notice date
point_in_time_policy.revision_policy: The public source is a current historical snapshot without immutable correction versions. Duplicate event identities, changed key schema, or incomplete pagination reject the source; EID is not used to choose a latest revision.
point_in_time_policy.residual_limitation: NOTICE_DATE has no intraday timestamp and the public historical snapshot can revise. Waiting to the next local session is conservative for same-date trading but cannot reconstruct removed historical rows.

acceptance_protocol.candidate_cross_section_definition: one announcement_date after point-in-time holding-universe filtering with at least six distinct instruments and at least two distinct factor values
required_checks: the mechanism audit, contract, holding universe, calendar, quarterly quality, accepted price-basis context, frontier, terminal record, and pilot execution policy fingerprints match before network access
only SECURITY_CODE, NOTICE_DATE, and EID are requested, every result row contains exactly these keys, and no credentials, cookies, proxies, or retail sessions are used
all three frozen windows report positive pages and rows within the eighty-page ceiling and every advertised page is fetched exactly once
each page retains identical pages and count metadata and concatenated received rows equal the provider-advertised count
every identity key is complete, strict, inside its partition, and globally unique across the three non-overlapping windows; complete unsupported-board rows are excluded and counted
point-in-time holding-universe filtering occurs on announcement_date before sample variation checks
the count and reciprocal formula reproduce exactly, every event count is a positive integer, and every factor lies in (0, 1]
each sample and the combined samples pass their frozen source-row, event-count, cross-section, name, and value-variation thresholds
the published frame contains only five normalized columns; EID and every forbidden source, financial, identity, text, price, valuation, credential, and return field are absent
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: write one terminal no-return source rejection, delete the hidden partial snapshot, and stop without another window, provider, field, aggregation, formula, direction, age, threshold, full sync, comparison, price, return, score, selection, sizing, or order
acceptance_protocol.one_shot_policy: The exact acceptance may publish at most one success or rejection manifest and every clone must reject a second attempt from the tracked result before loading the contract or issuing a request.

full_snapshot_contract_after_acceptance_.recursive_bisection: bisect an inclusive date range before fetching later pages when advertised pages exceed 80; a single date above the ceiling is fatal
full_snapshot_contract_after_acceptance_.failure_policy: delete the complete temporary snapshot, publish no final partition, write one terminal no-return source record, and stop without retry or price access

capacity_contract_after_full_source_only.quality_gate: ROE >= 5%, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY, effective only after the next local session following announcement

uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.sparse_insufficient_overlap_policy: record overlap and descriptive correlation without statistical pass or fail; semantic independence remains mandatory
